# Renderer regression fixtures

`Crate.md2` and `Satellite.lwo` are original MeshThumbs procedural assets,
© 2026 MeshThumbs contributors, under the [project MIT license](../../../../LICENSE).
They exercise missing Assimp UV metadata and LWS object resolution respectively.
They are separate from the internet-sourced README showcase.

The original generation scripts write to `target/procedural-examples/`.
